prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1365; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is now pursuing a claim for compensation.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please inform us so that we may address it.

We also request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page for that policy.

Finally, we ask that your company take immediate steps to preserve all evidence related to this collision. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, telematics information, repair estimates, and any surveillance or dashcam footage in your possession or in the possession of your insured.
